scope: Independent detailed-chemistry BVP domain and grid experiments, with actual stored diffusive fluxes and chemical mass sources used to audit global elemental conservation.

domain_experiment.species_equation_diagnostic: Original unmodified species equations, including the algebraically replaced dependent equation, integrated with rho and nonuniform dual widths; divided by integrated L1 net mass-production activity. Values reported without new accuracy gates.
limits: Only the independent constant-pressure reference BVP domain was extended. No native FV domain or boundary-reflection qualification.
All original nodes and anchor retained; only appended downstream-region spacing halved. Not a full-domain grid-convergence study.
Measured speed changes are comparable to repeating the saved steady solve at unchanged tolerances; not resolved physical differences.
The equilibrium temperature is a thermochemical endpoint diagnostic; finite-domain departure alone is not a numerical-error measure.
Raw BVP mass fractions and all original species residuals retained, including tiny negative roundoff; no native state imported or modified.
Reference and native share chemistry/transport data. No experiment or mature-combustor qualification.

flux_and_grid_analysis.method: Use actual stored BVP diffusion fluxes and chemical mass sources; positive velocity upwind derivative on each preceding interval, diffusion on nonuniform dual widths. For each element: boundary flux difference = integrated chemical source - integrated original equation residual + (advective boundary difference - integrated convective derivative).
flux_and_grid_analysis.normalization: Signed outlet-minus-inlet element flux [kg/m2/s] divided by prescribed incoming flux of that same element. Absent inlet elements remain null, with absolute defects retained. No new physical-accuracy gates.

runs.method: Identical five guesses, equations, tolerances and backend. New read-only export of actual stored diffusion and chemical mass sources after the same complete steady evaluation. All pre-existing output fields must be exactly equal.

grid_refinement_runs.method: Bisect every interval of the preceding solved BVP grid, retaining all original nodes and the exact temperature anchor. Linear interpolation supplies only the new initial guess. Re-solve the complete original equations at unchanged tolerances, mass constraint, pressure, inlet mixture and full multicomponent/Soret transport.

first_launch_failure_preserved.reason: The archived executable copy lacked execute permission; no BVP was launched. A separate directory used an executable-bit-preserving copy with the same binary hash.
